catalog.title: Seiko
catalog.note: 1932 (昭和7年) Hattori (服部時計店) premium-sale catalogue, セイコー景品附特賣: every Seiko wristwatch, 16-size railway watch and Seikosha pocket watch bought from 1 Feb 1932 came with a lottery ticket (draw 10 June 1932; prizes a Seikosha marble mantel clock, a gramophone, a diamond ring, a confectionery set and a desk clock — pictured on scan 14, no records). No model codes are printed: each pictured watch is a list of numbered case/jewel variants, so ref = romanised shape name + size + the printed number range (e.g. Seiko 9 Coin Ribbon No.72-83; バリー型 → Barry, 三味胴型 → Cushion, 千段縁 → Sendan-buchi, 七寶縁 → Shippo, 蛇ノ目 → Janome), with the Japanese name in code. Size 形 (10形/9形/8形, 17形, 十六サイズ) goes to specs. Price = every printed variant line in yen as printed (¥ with sen decimals), with its number, case (クローム側 chrome, 銀側 silver, 十八金側 18K gold with A號/一號/二號 grades, プラチナ側 platinum, ニツケル側 nickel) and jewels (七石 7, 十石 10, 十五石 15, 十六石 16, 十八石 18); jewels is set only when all variants share one count. Pages of loose dials (変り文字板, scans 6, 8 and 11 — option dials at the same price or 50/80 sen extra) are not watches and have no records. Scan 1 is the sale rules and factory photo; scan 15 the back cover. Printed page numbers run 1–12 on scans 2–13.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption and price-list crops at full resolution.
